data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'gol', meaning 'flower', and the suffix '-ara', which signifies 'golden'. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Golara usually hope their child will grow to embody golden flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
